本政策适用于鲸尾助手小程序版及其配套公网服务。小程序用于连接你自行配对的 Dee: This policy applies to the Whaletail Mini Program and its supporting public access services. The mini program connects to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) nodes that you pair yourself, not to a centrally operated AI host. The operator is identified on the WeChat mini program details page. For privacy questions, use this page or Settings → About → Contact support.
使用公网账号功能时，我们通过微信登录凭证识别当前小程序内的 OpenID，并建立: When you use public account features, we identify your OpenID within this mini program using WeChat login credentials and create a device ID beginning with WX-. This is a server-side account identifier, not your phone's hardware serial number. We also record account creation and last-access times, administrator permissions, public access expiry, redemptions and campaign rewards for authentication, entitlement synchronization and duplicate-claim prevention.
兑换码与赠送时长只用于公网服务，不限制你与自己的 DSH 节点进行局域网连接。管: Redemption codes and gifted time apply only to public access services. They do not restrict local connections to your own DSH nodes. Administrator access is granted by the backend; owning a DSH node does not automatically grant it.
如你主动启用实验性微信 ClawBot 私聊接线，授权微信账号收到的私聊内容会由: If you enable the experimental WeChat ClawBot private chat bridge, the gateway's built-in service on your paired computer submits messages received by your authorized WeChat account to the DSH session you select, where they are processed under that session's model and permissions. WeChat credentials and bridge state stay on the computer. The mini program only manages binding, the target session and enablement through your paired gateway; it does not receive or store WeChat login credentials. Do not route data through this feature if it is not appropriate for that DSH node or model service.
你发送的消息、主动选择的图片和文件，以及工作区、工具执行和历史会话数据，在小程序: Messages, images and files you choose to send, workspaces, tool execution data and conversation history are transferred between this mini program and your paired DSH node. Depending on your selected model and permissions, the node may send content to model providers or other tool services. Their processing and retention are governed by node configuration and the relevant service policies. Connect only to trusted nodes.
如你开启订阅提醒并在发送任务时同意微信授权，小程序会向配套公网服务申请一次性通知: If you enable subscription notifications and accept WeChat authorization when sending a task, the mini program requests a one-time notification ticket from its public service. After the task turn ends, your paired gateway submits that ticket, the session identifier and completion status, optionally with task statistics such as name, duration, token consumption and cache hit rate; it does not submit task text, files or model replies. The public service stores only a ticket digest, a hash of the OpenID, the session identifier and processing status, and deletes them within about three days. The session identifier is used to open the relevant conversation when the notification is tapped. The service sends a task-completion notification using the verified WeChat OpenID; it does not include task text or model replies.
配对信息、访问凭证、节点列表、外观偏好以及会话列表与正文缓存会保存在本机小程序存: Pairing information, access credentials, node lists, appearance preferences, conversation lists and cached message bodies are stored locally in the mini program for reconnection and history display. Device brand, model and other information may also be sent to the paired gateway to identify trusted devices. Keep pairing information secure and do not publish keys in announcements or group chats.
托管公网中继使用端到端加密传输会话载荷，中继仍需处理路由标识、连接鉴权及网络连接: The managed public relay uses end-to-end encryption for conversation payloads, but still processes routing identifiers, connection authentication and network connection information. Encryption for local connections and other deployments depends on their configuration; do not assume all connections provide identical protection.
扫码配对时按微信提示使用相机；添加附件时只处理你主动选择或拍摄的图片及文件。是否: QR pairing uses the camera as prompted by WeChat. Attachments include only images or files you choose or capture. You decide whether to grant permissions and need not provide this content when not using these features. Avoid uploading unrelated people's private information.
活动开放时，分享链接携带邀请标识。访客打开并确认参加后，服务端结合微信账号标识记: When campaigns are open, shared links include an invitation identifier. After a visitor opens the link and confirms participation, the server records the invitation relationship, valid visits and rewards using the WeChat account identifier to prevent duplicates and detect abuse. Forwarding or generating a link alone is not a successful share.
